title: Making Postgres Queues Scale
by: Qian Li and Peter Kraft, DBOS
summary: How DBOS got its Postgres-backed queues to 30,000 workflows a second: `SKIP LOCKED`, the weaker `READ COMMITTED` isolation unless a queue needs global limits, partial indexes on waiting rows only, and an index that matches the dequeue order. DBOS wrote it about its own product, but the techniques apply to any Postgres queue.
